pairwise.reason: Submission X is better for placement because it correctly orients the racks so that their perforated air-intake front doors face into the cold aisle as marked by the layout triangles; Submission Y mistakenly reversed the racks 180 degrees, placing their solid rear panels facing into the cold aisle. Conversely, Submission Y is better for aisle fitout because it fully implemented the required 600 mm perforated floor tiles in the cold aisle and modelled proper U-channel cable trays, whereas Submission X completely omitted the perforated floor tiles and used solid rectangular bars for the cable trays. Overall, each submission succeeds where the other fails (X correctly placing/orienting the racks while omitting the floor tiles; Y fully completing the fitout elements while failing rack orientation), resulting in a tie.
